scope: Exact retained host reproduction/correction artifacts; targeted JNI cancellation and resource retirement only, not complete-output recovery, speedup, device performance, or release qualification.
notes: The original receipt.json files are exact compile-only receipts: inferencePerformed=false and passed=false describe their compile-only workflow, not the separately invoked targeted JNI tests.
The before failure is recorded in its original JVM log; no synthetic passing receipt was created for that run.
The after targeted receipt records both successful JNI tests with source, compiled-class, runtime-dependency, input and model-manifest identities.
Archived source-snapshots include the generated no-op AppDiagnostics host adapter. Class/JAR/APK binaries and model/audio payloads are intentionally excluded.
